notes: The waw of וְשָׁאַל is rendered by the relative *who* under rule 17's waw-plus-finite-verb clause, no explicit subject pronoun standing in that recast clause.

*both he and all the children of Israel* writes the opening correlative before the first member, so the pair is one connective the ASV has written in two words and belongs to the single waw, headed on the closing *and* (rules 14, 25); the explicit הוּא keeps only its own *he*.
The final waw takes the *even* written for it (rule 14), and אִתּוֹ is the preposition H854 *with*, not the object marker (rule 16's closing caution).
